## KEY POINT

A moderate amount of dietary carbohydrate is needed for enhancing exercise performance. It is unclear how much carbohydrate intake is needed for maximizing exerciseinduced muscle hypertrophy, but 3 g/kg/day is a reasonable starting point.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
